This API is a new version of existing API XPm_DevIoctl API. It supports all the IOCTL functions supported by the old API and it adds support for a couple new ones. Users should migrate to using the new API signature in their applications. The older API will be deprecated and support for it may be removed in future releases. There are multiple reasons for introducing a new API signature:
The old API had fixed number of payload arguments, the new one supports variable length of payload buffer for forward compatibility
To maintain backwards compatibility for old API
For scalability reasons when support for "large payload" is introduced
